title: DME and position
summary: A radial and a distance make a point in the sky: fly the 090 radial out to the 25 DME fix.
briefing: We're on Robbinsville's zero niner zero radial, eight miles out. The DME tells us how far from the station we are.
Radial and distance together are a position: the zero niner zero radial at twenty-five DME is a fix you could find in any weather.

tasks.say: Keep the needle centred on the zero niner zero radial. The DME is on the HSI's corner.
tasks.sayGlass: Keep the course bar centred on the zero niner zero radial. The DME distance is in the corner of the navigation display.

tasks.goal: Fly to the 25 DME fix on the 090 radial.
tasks.say: Now watch the DME count up, and tell me when we reach twenty-five. Stay on the radial all the way: the fix is on the line, not beside it.
tasks.done: Twenty-five DME on the zero niner zero. That's the fix.

cues.say: We're drifting off the radial: needle left.

debrief.three: Right on the fix. You could hold there in cloud and nobody would worry.
debrief.two: Close to the fix. Keep the needle centred all the way to it.
debrief.one: We got to twenty-five, a little to one side. The radial matters as much as the distance.
debrief.failed: We didn't make the fix. Radial first, then the distance. Again?
